text: This was a very intimate and authentic performance by an extremely passionate dancer.   My expectations were fully realized with the ensambles earthy and culturally areal performance.   The added drink was a good touch!  OLE

title: Outstanding Flamenco in an Intimate Setting – Great Value and Amazing Staff!
text: An absolutely wonderful flamenco experience in the heart of Seville! Tablao Flamenco El Jardín de Murillo offers an intimate, authentic setting right by the Murillo Gardens in the Santa Cruz neighborhood, with a warm and welcoming atmosphere that makes you feel part of the show from the moment you arrive. The staff at the entrance were incredibly friendly and attentive (we were even greeted with a complimentary tinto de verano), and the whole team clearly takes pride in creating a special night for guests.
